podcast.title: Considered "Too Light" for Punk
podcast.body: In the mid-2000s, Hedley was categorized as a band that was "too light" or "too poppy for punk." This led to alt-rock radio stations refusing to play their music, citing that their fans were "too young" and lacked the "true spirit of punk and alternative music." Audiences would immediately complain upon hearing their songs. "groups like Headley and Simple Plan and Good Charlotte were maybe a little too light."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Influenced by Blink-182
podcast.body: Hedley is recognized as one of the artists whose work reflects the influence of Blink-182, pointing to Blink-182's impact on their sound or stylistic choices. "Some 41 good Charlotte simple-plan panic at the disco, followed boy, headly, billy talent, you would meet six, paramour, you know, you get the idea."

xref.title: Influence on Pop Punk
xref.body: Blink-182 is considered one of the most influential pop punk bands of the 21st century. Their style and career trajectory have left a significant mark on numerous artists across the genre, inspiring bands like Sum 41, Good Charlotte, Simple Plan, Panic! At The Disco, Fall Out Boy, Hedley, Billy Talent, You Me At Six, and Paramore. "Blink has to be considered one of the most influential pop punk bands of the 21st century."
